description: Dramatic bust portrait of the character from the reference: ZUGZWANG, the chess-grandmaster automaton with the ivory chess-king crown helmet with a cross, smooth ivory mask face with one narrow glowing red-orange eye slit, high black collar with gold trim, ivory pauldron, checkerboard chest plate with a glowing red-orange core. Three-quarter view facing right, head slightly lowered, cold confident stare, one black-gloved hand raised near the chin holding a small ivory chess king piece between two fingers. Dark background with faint glowing red-orange chessboard squares and floating chess pieces out of focus. Same art style as the reference: bold cel-shaded 2D fighting game art, thick clean dark outlines, strong rim light, high contrast. No text.
